description: We are Quantum Copper, an innovative tech team from Antofagasta, Chile—heart of the Atacama Desert and a global hub for astronomy and extreme environments. We are building Tailings & Waste SAR-Guard, a NISAR, Sentinel-1, and ground-robotics early-warning system detecting ground deformation and seepage to protect citizens near landfills and tailings dams like María Elena. Our strength combines software, satellite data analysis, and problem-solving inspired by northern Chile's resilience.
